Automated retry creates a new materialization and attempt number while preserving reporting_revision_id. available is a verified producer-hosted pull/share claim; delivered is a verified recipient/destination claim. Existing per-buy inline reporting remains on its existing data API and is outside this v1 managed ledger.

reporting_obligation_id.description: Destination-specific obligation this materialization attempts to satisfy.

delivery_config_id.description: Durable configuration that requested this materialization.

destination_ref.description: Immutable caller-owned destination generation selected by the account-authorized obligation. It may be reused by the same caller across other independently authorized accounts.

status.description: Lifecycle of this attempt. pending may transition once to available, delivered, or failed; terminal evidence is immutable. Staleness is evaluated in get_reporting_status health, not stored as a materialization state.

ready_at.description: When consumer-path or destination verification completed.

failure_code.description: Stable safe failure classification. MUST NOT include credentials or provider response bodies.

x-adcp-validation.revision_match: reporting_revision_id names destination-independent content. verification.row_count and control_totals MUST equal that revision; canonical_content_digest MUST also equal it when present.
x-adcp-validation.obligation_match: reporting_obligation_id, delivery_config_id, delivery_config_version, destination_ref, feed_purpose, and method MUST match one caller/account-bound obligation. This join is what permits one revision to fan out to many destinations and principals.
x-adcp-validation.authorization: The caller MUST be authorized for the referenced account and destination binding. Cross-caller and cross-account identifiers MUST be rejected without revealing whether they exist.

external:core/reporting-verification.jso.title: Reporting Verification
external:core/reporting-verification.jso.description: Producer evidence for one materialization, with an explicit assurance profile. Native commit and manifest profiles prove a committed destination plus row counts and control totals without claiming full logical-content equality. canonical_digest adds exact logical equality and is required for billing. A separate authenticated consumer receipt records what the consumer actually reconciled.

verified_at.description: When the producer completed verification through the claimed consumer/destination path.

verification_path.description: Path on which verification succeeded. dataset_share readiness requires representative_consumer; delivered warehouse state requires destination.

row_count.description: Verified row count. Zero explicitly distinguishes an empty committed revision from a missing revision.

control_totals.description: Profile-defined totals recomputed through verification_path. Names MUST be unique.

physical_checksums.description: Method-specific byte/object checksums. Different encodings of the same logical revision normally have different values.

native_commit_evidence.description: Provider-native immutable version evidence observed through the named consumer or destination path.

x-adcp-validation.revision_match: row_count and control_totals MUST equal the referenced revision. canonical_digest additionally requires a digest equal to the revision digest.
x-adcp-validation.assurance_boundary: native_commit and manifest_checksums prove committed delivery evidence but MUST NOT be described as cryptographic logical-content equality. That claim requires canonical_digest.
x-adcp-validation.native_version_match: When native_commit_evidence is present, native_version_ref MUST equal resource.native_version_ref and observed_through MUST match the consumer/destination verification path.
x-adcp-validation.checksum_binding: Every physical_checksums.object_ref MUST be an object selected by this exact immutable resource/manifest; algorithm and value length MUST agree.

external:core/reporting-verification-pro.title: Reporting Verification Profile
external:core/reporting-verification-pro.description: Assurance evidence used for one reporting materialization or receipt.

external:core/reporting-receipt.json.title: Reporting Receipt
external:core/reporting-receipt.json.description: Authenticated consumer evidence for one materialization. A receipt closes the knowledge gap between producer availability and consumer reconciliation. Buyer and governance consumers submit independently; neither consumer's receipt implies acceptance by another principal.

observed_native_version_ref.description: Immutable provider-native version observed by the consumer for native_commit verification.

consumer_commit_ref.description: Optional non-secret consumer checkpoint, transaction, or load identifier. It is evidence for operations, not authorization or a credential.

x-adcp-validation.authorization: The seller derives the consumer principal from authenticated transport and accepts receipts only for that principal's account-bound obligation and materialization. Unknown, unauthorized, cross-account, and cross-caller identifiers are indistinguishable.
x-adcp-validation.acceptance_match: accepted requires exact equality with the selected materialization verification evidence: row count and control totals always; canonical digest or manifest digest when selected. A mismatch MUST be submitted or recorded as rejected.
x-adcp-validation.immutability: A reporting_receipt_id is immutable. Exact retries are idempotent; reuse with different content is a conflict.
